definition: The two families of discrete speech tokens: semantic tokens (from SSL models like HuBERT) capture content and phonetics; acoustic tokens (from codecs) capture full sound including timbre and recording conditions.
details: The two families of discrete speech tokens: semantic tokens (from SSL models like HuBERT) capture content and phonetics; acoustic tokens (from codecs) capture full sound including timbre and recording conditions. Modern TTS pipelines often generate semantic tokens first, then acoustic tokens conditioned on them.
